text: CI now protects every code change. This lesson protects the pipeline's actual operation -- building the first real health checks on Snowpipe and the Stream feeding Pinehurst's inventory numbers.

A scheduled Task checks COPY_HISTORY for clean loads, and checks the Stream for an abnormally large backlog. One thing is deliberately not checked yet: whether the Task draining that Stream is still running.
Both checks run every fifteen minutes and log their results to a health table, so a stalled pipe or a ballooning backlog gets flagged automatically instead of discovered by accident.
That gap gets written into the project's own documentation, in plain sight, right next to what is covered -- not buried as an afterthought.
That exact gap is about to matter. Next: a regional inventory manager reports numbers that look frozen, and this lesson's blind spot is why nothing caught it yet.
